threat_event: Ransomware encrypts DC automation servers and WMS integration servers and halts shipping
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: DC automation servers joined to the corporate domain; vendor access outside SYS-G5 at three DCs
likelihood_basis: EV-010 (automation servers on the corporate domain); EV-064 (vendor tool outside SYS-G5 at three DCs)
regulatory_driver: 21 CFR 117.206(a)(3); contracts with stores and customers
existing_controls: EDR on IT; WMS is SaaS
treatment_plan: Move DC automation to the OT domain; offline backups; restore tests (POAM-018)
owner: Food Distribution security and compliance lead

threat_event: DC refrigerated room alerts stop and food is not evaluated after a temperature excursion
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Group alert integration server; no DC fallback alarms
likelihood_basis: EV-025 (one alert integration server); EV-066 (no alarm path independent of SYS-G6)
treatment_plan: Local fallback alarms at each DC; group failover (GR-02)

threat_event: Trailer telematics outage or tampering leaves in-transit temperature unknown
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Telematics vendor portal with shared dispatcher logins
existing_controls: Driver checks at loading and delivery
treatment_plan: Named telematics accounts with MFA; data feed into SYS-G6 with gap alerts

threat_event: One 3PL customer sees another customer's inventory or temperature data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Multi-customer portal; authorization tests only at major releases
likelihood_basis: EV-069 (authorization tests at major releases); EV-086 (customer questions on data separation)

threat_event: EDI messages are manipulated to redirect orders or shipments
treatment_plan: Rotate partner credentials; anomaly checks on ship-to changes

threat_event: DC automation vendor remote access at DC-2, DC-4, and DC-5 is misused
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor uses its own remote tool outside SYS-G5
likelihood_basis: EV-064 (vendor's own remote tool at DC-2, DC-4 and DC-5)
existing_controls: Firewall rules limit the tool to automation servers

threat_event: Staff follow the 2023 Food Distribution standards that conflict with group policy
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Standards not re-aligned since 2023 (log retention, termination timing, vendor access)
likelihood_basis: EV-063 (2023 standards: log retention, termination timing, vendor access)
owner: Food Distribution security and compliance lead

threat_event: Food Distribution cannot evidence inherited controls to auditors or 3PL customers
owner: Food Distribution security and compliance lead

threat_event: Temperature monitoring and corrective action records are not reviewed within 7 working days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Reviews done monthly at three DCs
treatment_plan: Weekly review workflow in SYS-G6 with sign-off (POAM-025)

threat_event: Business email compromise redirects payments to carriers or vendors
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor bank changes accepted by email at DCs
likelihood_basis: EV-086 (vendor bank changes accepted by email)

threat_event: WMS and automation logs retained 30 days limit an investigation
likelihood_basis: EV-064 (30-day log retention); EV-063 (2023 retention rule)
treatment_plan: Forward logs to the SIEM; 1-year retention (POAM-019)
owner: Food Distribution security and compliance lead

threat_event: A telematics vendor breach exposes driver location history
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor holds 2 years of location data
likelihood_basis: EV-065 (vendor holds 2 years of location data)
regulatory_driver: State breach laws (where location data is covered)
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Food Distribution security and compliance lead; data minimization requested at renewal
owner: Food Distribution security and compliance lead

threat_event: DC-1 or DC-3 freezer refrigeration controls are tampered with
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Controllers behind SYS-G5 but with local web interfaces
likelihood_basis: EV-023 (SYS-G5 at DC-1 and DC-3); EV-053 (DC-1 and DC-3 freezers above the ammonia threshold)
existing_controls: SYS-G5 at both DCs; PSM programs
treatment_plan: Credential sweep; disable local web interfaces

threat_event: A long WMS SaaS outage stops picking at all five DCs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single WMS tenant for all DCs
likelihood_basis: EV-064 (one WMS tenant for all DCs); EV-029 (WMS vendor report)
treatment_plan: Quarterly paper-picking drill at each DC

threat_event: DC shipment records cannot be joined to plant lots during a recall
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: WMS lot keys differ from MES lot codes
likelihood_basis: EV-064 (WMS lot keys differ from MES lot codes)
existing_controls: Manual join by the recall team

threat_event: The DCs cannot produce Food Traceability List records within 24 hours when enforcement starts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Key data elements not captured for listed foods
likelihood_basis: EV-095 (key data elements not captured for listed foods)
treatment_plan: Traceability plan and WMS changes by 2028-04-30

likelihood_basis: EV-086 (DC-1 serves about 60% of Florida stores); EV-062 (DC-1 hurricane plan with DC-3 overflow)

threat_event: Inventory records are manipulated to hide product theft
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Inventory adjustments approved by the same supervisor who requests them at two DCs
likelihood_basis: EV-064 (adjustments approved by the requesting supervisor at two DCs)
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Food Distribution security and compliance lead; cycle counts detect losses within a month
owner: Food Distribution security and compliance lead
